notes.title: True Disc Golf is fully compatible with Steam Deck
notes.notes: True Disc Golf is fully compatible with Steam Deck. For Steam Input It is recommended to download the Official Configuration for Steam Deck layout or Official Configuration layout and disable the back buttons.

notes.title: Introduction to True Disc Golf
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=9kTTro2heT0;full][/previewyoutube]
True Disc Golf has been in development for 8 years by a solo developer Sportsmanlike Games.

The focus of developing the game has been to make it as realistic as possible with the game being easy to learn but hard to master. The game features authentic disc flight, skips, rollers and wind to enjoy the round of disc golf in a familiar true to life environment.

Game is ready and polished and the plan is to release it on Steam platform during Summer 2025.

I hope you find it worthwhile to add it your wishlist

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2721210/True_Disc_Golf/

There’s also a discord channel you can join and follow the game at
https://discord.gg/Jnd4WmZHds


Jarkko
Sportsmanlike Games
